d: The war around Iran is creating an energy shock far beyond the countries directly involved, with rising oil prices and pressure on shipping routes affecting economies across Asia and beyond. In this video, Firstpost examines how Pakistan is responding to the crisis, from fuel shortages and emergency energy-saving measures to a subsidy programme facing difficulties for consumers. The video also looks at why Pakistan is particularly exposed because of its dependence on imported crude and gas. It then compares the impact on India, including its diversified oil imports, domestic ethanol…
